name: results-table
title: Results summary table
for_each: select id,code || ' ' || name as label from sites where status='active' and exists (select 1 from samples s where s.site_id=sites.id)

sections.title: Latest result at each location
sections.note: Non-detects show the LOR. Criteria are the guideline sets applied to the site and the limits of its consents. Check every value against the laboratory report.
sections.sql: select location,analyte,fraction,sampled_on,result,unit,criteria,case when exceeds then 'OVER' else '' end as over from latest_results where site_id=$1 order by location,analyte

sections.title: Data quality
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where rule like 'POLICY-%' and reference like (select code from sites where id=$1) || '/%' order by rule

name: consent-compliance
title: Consent compliance summary
for_each: select id,ref from consents where status='active'

sections.title: Results against the limits, last 12 months
sections.sql: select location,sampled_on,analyte,case when detected then value::text else '<' || lor end as result,unit,concat_ws(' to ',limit_low,limit_high) as limit_value,limit_unit,case when exceeds then 'NO' else 'yes' end as complies from result_screen where consent_id=$1 and sampled_on>=current_date-365 order by location,analyte,sampled_on

sections.title: Exceedances and what was done
sections.sql: select sample,sampled_on,analyte,value,unit,coalesce(action,'none recorded') as action,acted_on,action_ref from exceedances where consent_id=$1 order by sampled_on

name: chain-of-custody
title: Sample register
for_each: select distinct s.site_id as id,t.code from samples s join sites t on t.id=s.site_id where s.submitted_on is not null

sections.title: Samples sent to the lab
sections.note: The lab's chain of custody form is the record. This is the register of what went and what has come back.
sections.sql: select s.code as sample,coalesce(l.code,'') as location,s.sample_type,s.matrix,s.depth_m,s.sampled_on,s.sampler,s.lab,s.lab_report,s.submitted_on,(select count(*)::int from results r where r.sample_id=s.id) as results_back from samples s left join locations l on l.id=s.location_id where s.site_id=$1 order by s.sampled_on desc,s.code
